sketch: The server is brisk and a little busy — short answers, no small talk. It is lunchtime and most tables are full. A pot of tea sits on the counter.

opening_line.pinyin: nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào diǎn shénme?

learner_turn: 你好，什么菜最好吃？有什么喝的？你要一个牛奶和三个饼干
notes: Stream A table, first miss. One breath, three slots; the live run credited one. The table quoted 你好，你要一个牛奶和三个饼干 — the two asks are what makes it three facts, packed with the order. 饼干 is out of band (包子 is the in-band bun); the order is still an order.
